entries.name: TencentDB Agent Memory
entries.summary: Layered long-term memory, symbolic context offload and traceable drill-down to raw evidence.
entries.decisionReason: Adapt only explicit memory, provenance, correction/delete, TTL and context-budget patterns; do not import automatic persona extraction or the upstream runtime.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.summary: Structured browser automation for agents through Playwright accessibility snapshots and constrained tool calls.
entries.decisionReason: Pilot only in an isolated local/mock environment, pin the evaluated version and compare MCP with Playwright CLI plus Skills; never connect it to production or enable unsafe code execution.

entries.name: Anthropic Commerce Agents
entries.summary: Reference patterns for auditable agentic commerce flows, staged mutations, provenance and resilient UI state.
entries.decisionReason: Adapt staged mutation approval, provenance, server-owned identity and UI rehydration patterns; do not import the Python/Claude runtime or enable payment mutations, and treat this non-maintained repository only as a blueprint.

entries.name: System Design 101
entries.summary: Curated system-design concepts and diagrams for architecture learning and decision prompts.
entries.decisionReason: Use only as learning and architecture-decision prompts; do not copy assets, and require workload benchmarks plus SLO evidence before making infrastructure changes.
